reason: The sachets are already counted out, so I can toss them in my bag on work trips and not think about it. And a named lab with the report for my batch is the first time 'tested' sounds like more than marketing, plus $24.99 is an easy impulse buy.
objection: I'd still want to open the lab report myself and see it's a real report for my batch number, not just a nice-looking claim.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the product page didn't match the batch number, or the lab turned out to be unnamed or hard to look up, I'd skip it.
